symptom: after `alter entity … rename attribute Reference to CustomerReference`, `describe message definition collection` printed `Reference,`; check --references passed that output and exec refused it: has no attribute "Reference"
cause: describe printed the element's stored OriginalName, which lags a rename (Studio Pro refreshes it; CE6524 until then), while create resolves the member by attribute name; check never resolved message members at all
insight: A stored element can carry two names for one thing — a reference (Attribute: Module.Entity.CustomerReference) and its own label (OriginalName: Reference) — and only the reference follows a rename. Describe must print what create resolves against (the reference's last segment) and put the label in `as '…'`; that round-trips AND keeps the exposed contract name. Apply the same to member lookup by name (alter … drop member). For check/exec agreement, reuse newColumnAttrJudge: it answers only 'provably not an attribute', so a script that adds the attribute before the definition still passes.
